info.description: Provides access to Microsoft Dataverse actions and triggers for Power Platform environments.

post.summary: When a row is added, modified or deleted

parameters.name: Consistency

parameters.name: catalog
parameters.description: Using this header parameter to save catalog in flow definition and Microsoft Dataverse will ignore as they don't use this info

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Using this header parameter to save category in flow definition and Microsoft Dataverse will ignore as they don't use this info

parameters.name: subscriptionRequest
parameters.description: Subscription request
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the subscription request object. Required properties: version, url, message (when the flow triggers), entityname (table), scope. Optional: name, sdkmessagename, filteringattributes, filterexpression, postponeuntil, runas.

post.x-ms-description-for-model: Trigger a flow when a row is added, modified, or deleted in a Microsoft Dataverse table.

get.description: This action allows you to list the rows in a Microsoft Dataverse table that match the selected options. This connector was formerly known as Common Data Service (current environment).

parameters.name: prefer
parameters.description: The header parameter required to make Microsoft Dataverse return the created resource

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: The header parameter required to make Microsoft Dataverse return the odata id

parameters.name: x-ms-odata-metadata-full
parameters.description: The header parameter to customer to opt-in returning full odata metadata in response.
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to opt in to returning full OData metadata in the response. Optional.

parameters.name: entityName
parameters.description: Choose a table
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: REQUIRED. Set to the exact entity set name (plural collection name) of a Dataverse table that exists in the selected environment, chosen from the available table list - do NOT guess, invent, or assume a table name. Custom tables use a publisher prefix (e.g. dws_, cr3a_) and exist only if deployed to this environment; using a table that does not exist returns 404. Use get_tables to discover valid names if unsure. Examples: contacts, accounts, access_rights.

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Enter a comma-separated list of column unique names to limit which columns are listed
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Comma-separated list of column logical names to return. Omit to return all columns. Example: name,emailaddress1,telephone1.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: Enter an OData style filter expression to limit which rows are listed
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. OData $filter expression using column logical names and the comparison/logical operators eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, and, or. Wrap string and date values in single quotes. Example: statuscode eq 1 and revenue gt 1000.

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Columns to sort by in OData orderBy style (excluding lookups)
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Sort expression: one or more column logical names each followed by asc or desc. Example: createdon desc.

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: Enter an Odata style expand query to list related rows
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to an OData $expand expression to include related rows in the result. Leave empty to return no related rows.

parameters.name: fetchXml
parameters.description: Enter a Fetch XML query for advanced customization
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to a FetchXML query string for advanced querying. Leave empty to use the OData query options instead.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Enter the number of rows to be listed (default = 5000)
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Maximum number of rows to return. Accepts a positive integer up to 5000; defaults to 5000.

parameters.name: $skiptoken
parameters.description: Enter the skip token obtained from a previous run to list rows from the next page
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the skip token returned from a previous run to retrieve the next page of rows. Leave empty for the first page.

parameters.name: partitionId
parameters.description: An option to specify the partitionId while retrieving data for NoSQL tables
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the partition id when reading or writing NoSQL (elastic) tables. Leave empty for standard tables.

get.x-ms-description-for-model: Retrieve rows from a Microsoft Dataverse table using optional OData query options: $select to choose columns, $filter to filter, $orderby to sort, and $top to cap the number of rows. Returns the matching rows.

searchtype.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Query syntax mode: simple (default) or full for Lucene query syntax.

searchmode.description: Enter whether any or all of the search terms must be matched (default is any)
searchmode.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. any (default) matches rows containing any term; all requires every term to match.

top.description: Enter the number of search results to be listed (default = 50)
top.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 50.

filter.description: Enter an Odata style filter expression to narrow the search

entities.description: Enter a comma-separated list of tables to be searched (default is all tables)

items.description: Enter a table unique name to be searched (default is all tables)

entities.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Array of table names to limit the search to. Omit to search all searchable tables. Example: ["contacts", "accounts"].

orderby.description: Enter a comma-separated list of column unique names followed by asc or desc

items.description: Enter a column unique name followed by asc or desc

orderby.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Array of sort expressions, each a column name followed by asc or desc. Example: ["createdon desc"].

facets.description: Enter a comma-separated list of facet queries to narrow the search

items.description: Enter a facet query to narrow the search

facets.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Array of column names to compute facets for. Example: ["address1_city"].

skip.description: Enter the number of search results to be skipped
skip.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Number of results to skip for paging. Defaults to 0.

returntotalrecordcount.x-ms-description-for-model: Optional. Set to true to include the total matching record count in the response. Defaults to false.
